D1_SERIAL.prediction: memory CONTENT -> belief/access -> response; belief/access is the only channel
contradicting: P3b: mediator cut unobservable under CLAIM_ACCESS_UNKNOWN
D1_SERIAL.reasoning: Changing only memory content (same memory id, same E1/E2/claim) flips the later response between REROUTE and a typed refusal, and the flip is carried entirely by the native accessibility/permission channel. Clamping that channel (P4) removes the effect; withholding response history (P5) does not; a reference-only mediator (P8) does not reproduce it. However the mediator-CUT contrast is unobservable whenever the cell accessibility is CLAIM_ACCESS_UNKNOWN, so the serial path is identified only where access is permitting.
